'''2000 DecipherCon Closed Tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG closed-environment side event at [[DecipherCon 2000]] (5–8 October 2000, Kissimmee, Florida). The convention schedule lists three "Death Star II Constructed" side events. [[Andy McClure]] won a Jedi Luke shirt there with an Endor and Death Star II only Dark deck.<ref name="dt-11172">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11172 The Emperor's Little Buddies (Closed Environment deck)], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 15 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11172/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11172/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018105122/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11172/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 5–8 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Doubletree Resort, Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' Closed environment ([[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] and [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]])
